invite.subject: You’re invited to {workspace}
invite.body:
You’ve been invited to track time in {workspace}.

Set up your account here:
{link}

The link works for 7 days. If you weren’t expecting this, you can ignore it.

reset.subject: Reset your Timeclock password
reset.body:
Someone asked to reset the password for this address.

Choose a new one here:
{link}

The link works for an hour, once. If it wasn’t you, ignore this: your password hasn’t changed.

clockRunning.title: Your clock is still running
clockRunning.body: It has run for {hours} hours. Clock out, or fix the entry if you forgot.
